_comment: First half of a chained pair (run back-to-back, SAME session key, manually). A Deliberate task -> PlanWorkflow. cp1 completes; cp2 does three SEQUENTIAL slow_tool calls (~4s each ⇒ ~15s of blocking) before checkpoint_done. plan-continuation-followup must land during that window: while a plan is running the coordinator is workActive and forwards ANY new message straight to the PlanWorkflow (NewMessage signal -> pending), which folds it in at the next checkpoint boundary as a PlanHandling turn <plan_id>:followup:1. (ResolveOpenPlan's attach/supersede branch only runs across a coordinator restart mid-plan, not scriptable here.) After cp2 completes, foldInFollowups runs the follow-up turn, then the plan finishes.

message.content: Design and roll out a feature-flag system for the web app: pick an approach, add the evaluation hook, and migrate one existing hard-coded toggle to it.

checkpoints.intent: Choose a feature-flag approach (build vs library vs SaaS)
checkpoints.done_when: the approach is chosen with a one-line rationale

checkpoints.intent: Add the flag-evaluation hook and migrate one hard-coded toggle
checkpoints.done_when: one toggle reads through the new hook and its old constant is gone

checkpoint_responses.content: Chose a small in-house evaluator backed by a config table — no external dependency, boolean flags only for now.
Adding the hook — running the config-table migration.
Hook added; migrated the beta-dashboard toggle to read through it and removed the BETA_DASHBOARD constant. Tests pass.
